import json,sys,tempfile,subprocess,runpy,copy

sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('tools').resolve()))
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib import cli_lint
root=Path.cwd(); task=root/'.ai/task/repair-w68-20261012'; evidence=root/'evidence/quality/repair-window-68-20261012'
tempfile.tempdir=str(evidence)
fix=json.loads((task/'FIX4-TARGETS.json').read_text()); assert len(fix)==1
rid,f=next(iter(fix.items())); adj=json.loads((task/'ADJUDICATION-F3.json').read_text()); assert len(adj['findings'])==1 and adj['findings'][0]['status']=='confirmed' and adj['findings'][0]['revision_key']==rid
items=json.loads((task/'WORKSET.json').read_text())['items']; assert len(items)==106
item=next(x for x in items if x['entry_revision_identity']==rid)
files=json.loads((task/'SCOPE.json').read_text())['allowed_files']; assert len(files)==4
loader=LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
raw_before={n:(root/n).read_bytes() for n in files}
def records(data,n):
 return [{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!='line'} for r in loader.load_bytes(data,logical_path=n).records]
before={n:records(raw_before[n],n) for n in files}
base={n:records((task/'baseline'/n).read_bytes(),n) for n in files}
old,new=f['old_target'],f['new_target']; assert new==old+'\n' and old.count('\n')==5 and new.count('\n')==6
needle=('[['+old+']]').encode(); replacement=('[['+new+']]').encode(); assert raw_before[f['file']].count(needle)==1
expected=raw_before[f['file']].replace(needle,replacement,1)
(root/f['file']).write_bytes(expected)
after={n:records((root/n).read_bytes(),n) for n in files}
counts={}; changed_keys=set(); round_delta=[]
for n in files:
 assert len(base[n])==len(before[n])==len(after[n])
 counts[n]=0
 assert (root/n).read_bytes()==(expected if n==f['file'] else raw_before[n])
 for b,p,a in zip(base[n],before[n],after[n]):
  if b!=a:
   assert b['kind']==a['kind']=='translation'
   assert {k:v for k,v in b.items() if k!='target'}=={k:v for k,v in a.items() if k!='target'}
   counts[n]+=1; changed_keys.add((n,a['section'],a['source'],a['source_tag']))
  if p!=a:
   assert n==f['file'] and a['section']==item['section'] and a['source']==item['source'] and a['source_tag']==item['source_tag']
   assert p['target']==old and a['target']==new
   assert {k:v for k,v in p.items() if k!='target'}=={k:v for k,v in a.items() if k!='target'}
   round_delta.append(rid)
assert sum(counts.values())==106
assert changed_keys=={(x['normalized_path'],x['section'],x['source'],x['source_tag']) for x in items}
assert round_delta==[rid]
print('LuaJIT baseline/before/after comparison: PASS',counts,'total 106; round delta 1; exact new_target; all other semantic records unchanged')
print('BEFORE (JSON):',json.dumps(old,ensure_ascii=False)); print('AFTER (JSON):',json.dumps(new,ensure_ascii=False))
check=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check'],capture_output=True,text=True); print('git diff --check:',check.returncode,check.stdout,check.stderr); assert check.returncode==0
captured={}
cli_lint.create_run_directory=lambda *args:evidence
cli_lint.write_json=lambda path,report:captured.update(copy.deepcopy(report))
sys.argv=['tools/i18n','lint','--strict']
try: runpy.run_path('tools/i18n',run_name='__main__')
except SystemExit as e: lint_code=e.code or 0
else: lint_code=0
print('python3 -B tools/i18n lint --strict (runpy; report storage adapted in memory):',lint_code); assert lint_code==0 and captured['ok']
vp=evidence/'VALIDATION.json'; val=json.loads(vp.read_text())
val['review_cycle_4_repair']={'confirmed_findings':1,'changed_targets':[rid],'only_adjudicated_replacements_changed':True,'replacements':fix,'newlines_before':5,'newlines_after':6,'trailing_tabs_or_spaces_added':False,'literal_forms_preserved':'[[...]]'}
val['checks']['review_cycle_4']={'luajit_baseline_record_comparison':{'result':'passed','changed_targets':106,'counts_by_file':counts,'round_delta':1,'new_targets_exact':True,'other_records_unchanged':True,'args_order_unchanged':True,'byte_changes_only_expected_literal':True},'git_diff_check':{'command':'git diff --check','result':'passed','exit_code':0},'strict_lint':{'command':'python3 -B tools/i18n lint --strict','result':'passed','exit_code':lint_code,'report_storage_note':'Unchanged CLI executed via runpy; only report destination/storage adapted in memory. Full report inline here. Temporary Lua bridge files confined to this evidence directory and automatically removed; no .artifacts writes.','report':captured}}
vp.write_text(json.dumps(val,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
ip=evidence/'IMPLEMENTATION.md'
with ip.open('a') as out:
 out.write('\n## Repair round 4 (ADJUDICATION-F3)\n\n- `'+rid+'` (`mod-tome.lua`, Arcane Destruction): append exactly one LF after the final sentence; original `[[...]]` long brackets preserved, closing brackets at column 1. No tabs or spaces added.\n- Before (JSON escapes): '+json.dumps(old,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n- After (JSON escapes): '+json.dumps(new,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n- LuaJIT loaded all four translations before/after and their frozen baselines: exactly 106 baseline target changes (78 / 7 / 11 / 10); this round changed exactly one target, equal to `FIX4-TARGETS.json` new_target. Other records and args_order unchanged. LF count 5 → 6; file bytes changed only by the expected literal replacement.\n- `git diff --check`: passed. `python3 -B tools/i18n lint --strict`: passed, 30308 translations, 0 errors, 0 warnings. CLI executed through runpy with report destination/storage adapted in memory; complete report in VALIDATION.json. Temporary bridge files confined here and removed; no .artifacts writes.\n- No stage, commit, push, agent creation, task-record, terminology, or other entry changes. No unresolved issues or scope deviations.\n')
final=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check'],capture_output=True,text=True); assert final.returncode==0,(final.stdout,final.stderr)
for p in [vp,ip]:
 assert all(not line.endswith((' ','\t')) for line in p.read_text().splitlines())
print('Final git diff --check and evidence trailing-whitespace check: PASS')
